questions.prompt: What is the big idea of How a Flowering Plant Grows?
choices: Flowering plants grow from seeds and make new seeds.
Only seeds come in many shapes.
Only a shoot reaches light and opens its first leaves.
questions.answer: Flowering plants grow from seeds and make new seeds.
questions.rationale: Seeds come in many shapes. Each holds a tiny plant inside. A shoot reaches light and opens its first leaves. Plant one seed, add water, and watch the whole story begin again. Together, these facts show the whole-book big idea: Flowering plants grow from seeds and make new seeds.
